verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents first-party agent-framework integrations. Each one gives an agent a persistent browser plus `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` tools. Documented pages cover a Claude Code agent over MCP/stdio, a CrewAI integration (v4 server pattern and the v3 StagehandTool), and a Deep Agents integration with two deployment patterns. That delivers the core of plugging the browser layer into agent frameworks via documented adapters. missing for 10: evidence of a Vercel AI SDK adapter, an explicitly named LangChain adapter, a Claude Agent SDK adapter as distinct from Claude Code over MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of the adapters.
